# file: /etc/sudoers
Defaults	env_reset
Defaults	secure_path="/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin"
Defaults:backup	!authenticate

# User privilege specification
root	ALL=(ALL:ALL) ALL
%sudo	ALL=(ALL:ALL) ALL
# ops	ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL   (commented out, must be ignored)

@includedir /etc/sudoers.d

# file: /etc/sudoers.d/90-cloud-init-users
# Created by cloud-init v. 23.1 on Mon, 02 Oct 2023 10:00:00 +0000

# User rules for ubuntu
ubuntu ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL

# file: /etc/sudoers.d/deploy
deploy	ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/systemctl restart app, \
	/usr/bin/systemctl status app
jenkins	ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/ls, PASSWD: ALL
%ops	ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: SETENV: ALL
ansible	ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL

# unreadable: /etc/sudoers.d/legacy
